name: @afklink/protocol
description: Single source of truth for the AFKLink wire protocol: zod schemas, generated JSON Schema, and golden fixtures shared by server, Mini App and the Rust agent.
//sideEffects: Nothing here runs on import - it only declares schemas and constants. Saying so lets a bundler drop the zod runtime from the Mini App, which needs types and a few constants but never validates: without it the viewer bundle doubled, on a WebView app that people open over mobile data.
